# reads

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/loki/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/loki/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

Loki-owned LogQL range, metric and label selections and mandatory selector equalities.

`connectors_loki.reads` is one of connectors_loki's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `LabelSelection`

`connectors_loki.reads.LabelSelection` is a record of four fields:

- `label` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `start_unix_ns` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `end_unix_ns` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `query` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(label.count >= 1 and label.count <= 128)` and `(query.count >= 1 and query.count <= 16384)`.

### `LogDirection`

`connectors_loki.reads.LogDirection` is one of `forward` and `backward`.

### `LogRangeSelection`

`connectors_loki.reads.LogRangeSelection` is a record of seven fields:

- `query` — `String`
- `start_unix_ns` — `String`
- `end_unix_ns` — `String`
- `direction` — `connectors_loki.reads.LogDirection`
- `page_limit` — `Integer`
- `collection_limit` — `Integer`
- `max_line_bytes` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(page_limit >= 1 and page_limit <= 1000)`, `(collection_limit >= 1 and collection_limit <= 1000)`, `(max_line_bytes >= 1 and max_line_bytes <= 8192)`, `(start_unix_ns.count >= 1 and start_unix_ns.count <= 19)`, `(end_unix_ns.count >= 1 and end_unix_ns.count <= 19)`, `(start_unix_ns == 0 or not (start_unix_ns starts_with "0"))` and `(end_unix_ns == 0 or not (end_unix_ns starts_with "0"))`.

### `LogScopeEquality`

`connectors_loki.reads.LogScopeEquality` is a record of two fields:

- `label` — `String`
- `value` — `String`

### `MetricResultType`

`connectors_loki.reads.MetricResultType` is one of `vector`, `matrix` and `scalar`.

### `MetricSelection`

`connectors_loki.reads.MetricSelection` is a record of five fields:

- `query` — `String`
- `time_unix_ns` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `start_unix_ns` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `end_unix_ns` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `step_seconds` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(query.count >= 1 and query.count <= 16384)` and `((not (defined(start_unix_ns)) and not (defined(end_unix_ns)) and not (defined(step_seconds))) or (not (defined(time_unix_ns)) and defined(start_unix_ns) and defined(end_unix_ns) and defined(step_seconds)))`.

Four of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_loki.reads.LabelSelection`, `connectors_loki.reads.LogRangeSelection`, `connectors_loki.reads.MetricResultType` and `connectors_loki.reads.MetricSelection`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
